name: Diligence workspace access
description: Who may do what in the buyer's diligence workspace. It was governed before defaults existed, so it allows what no policy governs until an owner opts in: whatever no policy denies proceeds, as it did through v4.

policies.description: The deal lead reads and changes the workspace's model.
The buyer's deal lead administers policies on the diligence domain and inside it, and reads its records. The workspace grants it, so the deal lead cannot widen it.
